title: From BackTrack to Kali: The History of the Pentesting Distro
explainer: Kali Linux wasn't built from scratch - it's a 2013 rewrite, by Offensive Security's Mati Aharoni and Devon Kearns, of their earlier BackTrack distribution, which itself grew out of the Knoppix-based security-tools scene. Knowing Kali is one link in a chain of purpose-built security distributions explains why it looks and behaves like ordinary Debian Linux underneath, with a curated set of security tools layered on top, rather than something exotic.
